name: Imatinib for dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP)

biomarkers.note: GATE: DFSP is driven by the t(17;22)(q22;q13) COL1A1::PDGFB fusion, which produces a PDGFB autocrine loop that imatinib (a PDGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor) targets. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Dermatofibrosarcoma Protuberans v2.2026, confirm the COL1A1::PDGFB translocation by FISH before imatinib (footnote i). DeVita 12th ed. describes DFSP as a sarcoma characterized by COL1A1-to-PDGFB fusion for which imatinib is active.

lineOfTherapy: systemic therapy for unresectable, recurrent, or metastatic DFSP; also neoadjuvant to enable resection with acceptable functional/cosmetic outcome

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026 (10/24/2025), footnote i line 335 (Confirm COL1A1::PDGFB translocation by FISH); Discussion lines 686 to 687 (NCCN Panel recommends the COL1A1::PDGFB translocation be confirmed by FISH)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: unresectable following multiple resections, recurrent, or metastatic; or neoadjuvant where resection with negative margins would cause unacceptable functional/cosmetic outcome
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, line 315 (Consider Imatinib where disease is unresectable), footnote f line 289 (neoadjuvant imatinib), Discussion lines 682 to 685

drugs.name: Imatinib

provenance.locator: line 315 (Consider Imatinib where disease is unresectable/recurrent/metastatic) and footnote f line 289 (neoadjuvant Imatinib); NCCN does not print the imatinib dose

drugs.notes: VERIFY: Imatinib is FDA-approved for unresectable, recurrent, and/or metastatic DFSP (DeVita 12th ed. lines 664 to 667), but NONE of the provided sources print a DFSP-specific imatinib dose. The only imatinib dose in the sources (DeVita line 278172, 400 mg/day) is stated for CHRONIC MYELOID LEUKEMIA and must NOT be cross-applied to DFSP. The DFSP dose (per label typically 400 mg/day PO, escalating toward 800 mg/day for progression) must be VERIFY-ed against a cited source before this field is set. Continuous daily oral dosing (represented here as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle). Monitor for edema/fluid retention and hepatotoxicity (LFTs).

supportiveCare: Imatinib: monitor for fluid retention/edema (periorbital, peripheral) and weight gain.
Imatinib: monitor liver function (hepatotoxicity); check CBC (cytopenias) periodically.
Continue until progression, unacceptable toxicity, or (neoadjuvant) until resectable.

monitoring: edema/fluid retention and weight assessment - imatinib
tumor response assessment to determine resectability (neoadjuvant) or disease control (advanced)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 hepatotoxicity or significant fluid retention
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or reduce imatinib per labeling for significant hepatotoxicity or fluid retention; clinical review required.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 22653 (DFSP is a sarcoma characterized by fusion of COL1A1 to PDGFB; imatinib active); Discussion lines 664 to 667 (imatinib mesylate FDA-approved for unresectable, recurrent, and/or metastatic DFSP) and lines 680 to 686 (imatinib as monotherapy/adjuvant/neoadjuvant response rates; confirm COL1A1::PDGFB by FISH); Harrison 22nd ed. line 104074 (imatinib targets KIT and PDGF and is standard therapy for DFSP). None state a DFSP-specific dose.

guideline.locator: Treatment: Consider Imatinib where disease is unresectable/recurrent/metastatic (line 315); neoadjuvant Imatinib (footnote f, line 289); confirm COL1A1::PDGFB translocation by FISH (footnote i, line 335; hallmark t(17;22)(q22;q13), lines 184 to 185 and 363 to 364). NCCN does not print the dose.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for imatinib in dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP). The indication (unresectable, recurrent, metastatic; and neoadjuvant to enable resection) and the mandatory COL1A1::PDGFB FISH gate are grounded in Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Dermatofibrosarcoma Protuberans v2.2026 (line 315, footnote f line 289, footnote i line 335, hallmark t(17;22) lines 184 to 185) and DeVita 12th ed. (lines 22653 and 664 to 686) with Harrison 22nd ed. support (line 104074). However, NONE of the provided sources print a DFSP-specific imatinib dose; the only imatinib dose present (DeVita line 278172, 400 mg/day) is stated for chronic myeloid leukemia and was deliberately NOT cross-applied. The imatinib dose is therefore the literal VERIFY (never invented) and is listed in verifyFields; per the schema this blocks status ACTIVE. Continuous daily oral dosing is represented as a 28-day cycle. Imatinib edema/fluid-retention and LFT monitoring are enforced. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
